g.text: The pathogenicity score rises at low glucose through the pro-regulatory arm in 4 of 4 animal pairs
GSE289733, 8 libraries from 2 animals crossed over all four conditions | each line is one animal's paired
libraries; scores use the authors' Table S1 modules with their highly-variable-gene flags
Two animals. Each panel shows four paired differences and no test is performed; cell-level standard errors would describe cells, not mice. Scores are RNA module summaries, not
measurements of pathogenicity, enzyme activity or flux.
